title: SB19’s Josh Cullen collaborates with Jay Park on new track ‘Like Me’

blocks.text: Josh Cullen of P-pop powerhouse SB19 is set to release his new song “Like Me,” a collaboration with Korean-American rapper and model Jay Park. The upcoming track was announced by 1Z Entertainment through its Instagram page on Monday, Sept. 21. The collaboration is set for release on Thursday, Sept. 24 at 7 p.m. View this post on Instagram A post shared by 1Z ENTERTAINMENT (@1zentertainment.ph) Days after the release, Cullen is then set to hold a showcase on Saturday, Sept. 26, at a mall in Taguig City.
